verdict.overall: The biggest move since Sunday is TSLA, up almost 7% yet still facing opposing options pressure on every expiry through late November - confidence in a clean TSLA breakout stays low despite the rally. PLTR, NVDA and ZETA actually improved, flipping from opposing to neutral on some weeks even as their prices fell, while META and AMAT show magnet levels sliding down with price - weaker setups. AVGO and MU look steadiest for range-based trades with little change since Sunday, but earnings for AMD, PLTR, NVDA, ZETA, AMAT and APP all land inside the next four weeks, and options are pricey or very pricey on PLTR, APP, ZETA and the later NVDA/SPY/QQQ expiries - the main caution.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker - despite a near 7% price jump, options still lean against further upside on all four weeks, and the 11-13 expiry flipped from neutral to opposing, with the ceiling now higher near $425.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: little changed - price up modestly, neutral stance holds across all four weeks, with the ceiling sitting just above price near $352.50 nearest term.
tickers.META: Since Sunday: weaker - price down 3.5% and magnet and ceiling levels dropped sharply too (nearest ceiling now $645 versus $730 before), though the rating itself stays neutral. Trend is down.
tickers.AMD: Since Sunday: little changed - price down slightly, near-term neutral stance holds though 11-20 stays opposing with resistance near $480. Earnings on Nov 3 add risk, and the nearest options are pricey.
tickers.MU: Since Sunday: little changed - price up almost 2%, neutral stance holds across all four weeks with magnets easing slightly toward $950. No earnings inside this window.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: stronger - though price fell nearly 5%, both the 11-13 and 11-20 expiries flipped from opposing to neutral, easing resistance. Earnings on Nov 2 add risk, and options stay pricey to very pricey throughout.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: slightly stronger - price down 2.4% but the 11-20 expiry flipped from opposing to neutral, with near-term magnets easing down alongside price. Earnings Nov 17 falls inside this window; later expiries turn pricey.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: stronger - despite an 8% price drop, both the 11-13 and 11-20 expiries flipped from opposing to neutral. Earnings Nov 9 falls inside this window and options are very pricey throughout; the nearest expiry has few contracts held, so its magnet carries little weight.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: little changed - price up 5%, neutral stance holds across all four weeks though magnets eased down toward price, now clustered near $420-450. Earnings Nov 12 falls inside this window; later options turn pricey.
tickers.APP: No Sunday baseline. Today: neutral across all four weeks, but options are very pricey throughout and price near $236 sits well below magnet levels around $280-300. Earnings Nov 4 falls inside this window, adding risk.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed - price roughly flat, neutral stance holds across all four weeks. Nearest week: magnet £109.27, floor £106.57, ceiling £111.97 (VUSA terms); options remain pricey throughout, with no earnings to track.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: little changed - price down 1.4%, neutral stance holds across all four weeks. Nearest week: magnet £80.55, floor £77.49, ceiling £83.89 (rough ISUS equivalents, since ISUS only partly tracks the Nasdaq).
